Gray swept-back hair and round brass-rimmed spectacles.
Keep blue/cyan suit, teal shadows, white shirt, burgundy cravat, brown boots, and brass details in their established palette roles.
Preserve cane, rapier, and occult steel boomerang; violet effect only on the boomerang.
Remain fully human; no monster traits or unapproved costume changes.
